notes: Both items are private family recordings, not children's programs: a father speaks Yiddish with his son, who is about to turn three (upsherin on Daled Tammuz 5741, the Hakhel year). Classified family_recording with private_family and minor_named.
'SZ' in the filenames matches the child's initials (Shneur Zalman). The father is never named; identify him if the family is known to the user.
Parts 1 and 2 are one home session during Sefiras HaOmer 5741, probably two sides of one tape. Marked as part 1 and part 2 of a 2-part set, with part 2 continuing part 1.
Part 2 retells the Rabbi Akiva, Rashbi/Lag BaOmer and Matan Torah stories. There may be same_story links to Lag BaOmer and Shavuos items elsewhere in the archive.
